metadata.title: FENATEVI — Vitória National Theatre Festival
metadata.description: The Vitória National Theatre Festival brings performances, encounters and training to the city's theatres and squares.

common.externalLinkNotice: Registration takes place on a form outside this site.

footer.description: Held in Vitória, Espírito Santo, since 2004. This site is also the festival’s permanent archive.

acervo.languageNotice: Archive records — titles, press releases, credits and biographies — are kept in their original language, Brazilian Portuguese.
acervo.demoNoticeBody: The programme for the {edition}th edition has not been published yet. Until then, this site shows the complete archive of the {year} edition.

memoria.title: The festival's memory
memoria.description: Two decades of editions. Each with its archive at a different stage of digitisation.
memoria.periodUnknown: Dates to be confirmed in the archive

entries.2026: Curation under way. Programme, performances and honourees will be published by the organisers.
entries.2025: Records, programme and photographs still to be added to the digital archive.
entries.2024: Official Showcase, parallel showcase, workshops, book launches, creative processes and two honourees.
entries.2004-2023: Printed programmes, posters, photographs and video records to be digitised and published progressively.

memoria.noPageNotice: This edition does not have its own page yet.
memoria.scopeNote: Each published edition may include visual identity, summary, complete programme, performances, photographs, honourees, news, graphic materials, documents, participants and sponsors.

preview.noticeBody: The 2005–2023 editions are here so the timeline can be evaluated: the photographs are illustrative and do not depict the festival, and the archive percentage is an estimate. The 2024, 2025 and 2026 editions are real data.
